label: A hand-written example day: 40 questions to Larkspur’s assistant, with hand-set outcomes and toy costs, not a real run.

kinds.name: Everyday
kinds.about: Questions the handbook in the assistant’s prompt already answers.

kinds.name: Puzzles
kinds.about: Several steps of working out, like how many boards fill three walls.

kinds.name: Stock
kinds.about: Today’s stock and prices, which the model can’t know without looking.

kinds.name: Totals
kinds.about: Order totals, where one slip in the sums gives a wrong bill.

kinds.name: Warranty
kinds.about: Hard reading: long warranty terms with exceptions inside exceptions.

requests.text: What time does the Quay Street shop open on Sunday?
Shelf boards are 90 cm. How many fill three walls of 2.4 m, two shelves high?
Is the 18 V drill in stock at Quay Street today?
Do you deliver on Saturdays?
What do 12 hinges at £3.40 and 3 handles at £7.15 come to?
Can I return paint once the tin is open?
What does the oak decking cost per metre this week?
A 5 litre tin covers 60 m². How many tins for a 4 × 5 m room, walls only, 2.5 m high, two coats?
Do you cut keys while I wait?
My mower’s motor burnt out after a power cut. Does the warranty cover it?
When will the cordless sanders be back in stock?
Is there parking at the Mill Lane shop?
I bought 40 screws at 9p, a saw at £14.99 and two clamps at £6.50. What’s my total?
Which is cheaper per tile: a box of 12 at £18 or a box of 20 at £28?
Do you sell gift cards?
How many 2.4 m pine battens does the Quay Street shop have?
How long do refunds take to reach my card?
The drill’s battery swelled after I left it charging. Am I covered?
I need fence posts every 1.8 m along a 16 m fence. How many posts?
With 15% off, what do four tins of paint at £22 come to?
Can I order online and collect in store?
Is the red garden hose on offer right now?
How many 25 kg bags of concrete for 3 post holes, each 30 × 30 × 60 cm?
Do you have a trade discount?
Delivery is £6 under £50. What do I pay for a £44 ladder and £5 of bolts?
Which shop has the most wall tiles in white right now?
What’s your phone number for complaints?
I bought the saw for my business. Does the home warranty still apply?
Two 1.2 m shelves hold 30 kg each; brackets take 20 kg. How many brackets per shelf?
Can I hire a carpet cleaner?
Has my special-order sink arrived at Mill Lane?
Split my £86.40 order across three equal payments: how much each?
Do you recycle old batteries?
My door is 76 cm wide; the frame gap is 78.5 cm. Which standard door fits?
What’s today’s price on 10 litres of white emulsion?
Is the café at Quay Street open late on Thursdays?
The heater was fitted by a friend, not an electrician. Is it still under warranty?
A roll of wallpaper is 10 m by 53 cm. How many rolls for a 3 m wall, 2.4 m high?
Price-match £19.99 against a rival’s £17.50 on five lamps: how much do I save?
Do you sell spare keys for the garden padlock?
